subject.title: fix(agents): agent-created files get lowercased names on Windows

question: Does OpenClaw want `src/infra/path-guards.ts` to own a case-preserving mirror of fs-safe Windows normalization for paths returned to file-writing callers?
rationale: The patch appears to preserve boundary structure while changing a helper immediately adjacent to sandbox containment; choosing the long-term ownership and contract boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the local preserving-case helper
options.body: Keep the helper and its equivalence tests because agent file-writing callers need returned path spelling, while fs-safe remains the comparison-key owner.

options.title: Move the capability into fs-safe
options.body: Expose a supported case-preserving normalization primitive upstream, then consume it here to avoid mirrored normalization logic.

recommendation.title: Accept the local preserving-case helper
recommendation.body: Keep the helper and its equivalence tests because agent file-writing callers need returned path spelling, while fs-safe remains the comparison-key owner.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the recorded assignee and is best positioned to choose the desired sandbox-boundary ownership.
